title: Item:Night-Black Coffee

{{Consumable | picdesc = Night-Black Coffee.png | acquired = [[DDO Store]] | location = | turnin = {{Cost|19|inline=true}} | minlevel = 1 | reqtrait = | umd = | bind = {{Bind|BtA|BoA}} | effect = [[Night-Black Coffee Health Vigor]]; [[Night-Black Coffee Spell Vigor]]; [[Night-Black Coffee Boost]] (after death); [[Fatigued]] (after effect end); twitchy (after effect end; visual only, even while "sleeping") - Duration: 10 minutes (CL: 1) | durability = | material = | hardness = | cost = 300 pp | weight = 0.01 lbs | description =

This beverage has a strong, invigorating smell and is as black as a starless night sky.

When you drink this, you will become full of energy for 10 minutes (removing fatigue and exhaustion and making you immune to sleep) and regenerate hit points, spell points, bardic music uses, and turn undead attempts much more rapidly while you are in public areas. Your movement speed will also increase for the duration of the effect.

This item can only be used in public areas, and persists through death but not through rest or entering a dungeon. Alas, the coffee is luke-warm at best. | notes =
** Cost is {{Cost|95|inline=true}} for 5 Night-Black Coffees, i.e. {{Cost|19|inline=true}} each. ** It always works, not only during [[:Category:Events|events]]. ** Practically equivalent to {{Item|Butter-Rum Coffee}}. Both kinds of coffee have the same effects. ** {{Bug|It does not regenerate bardic music uses and turn undead attempts any faster.}} | Category1 = DDO Store potions | Category3 = Buffs }}
